pages.text: Food gives protein, fat, carbs and vitamins (dishes are counted from their recipes). Key $(l)K$() — how you feel.

- Low protein — slow healing, weaker hits.$(br)- Low fat — chilly.$(br)- Low carbs — no energy.$(br)- Low vitamins — sick more often.$(br)- Balanced — better healing and immunity.$(br2)Exact values — only by a blood test.
$(l)Fed up$(): the same food gets boring — slower eating, worse uptake. Variety helps.
